# IRIS full-system DEEP audit — sealed return for STRATA

**IRIS_FULL_SYSTEM_DEEP_AUDIT_COMPLETE / HOLD / NEW_BASELINE_REQUIRED / NO_GATE_PROGRESS**

Under the founder's direct full-system expansion of BIG #703/5965679103, the sole substantive Work auditor consumed the entire frozen candidate repository, the governing foundation and transition Blueprints, all qualification source, all permitted replacement-E1 inputs, the standalone binding package and current falsifiers. No sub-agent performed the reasoning or judgment.

**Selected salvage boundary: D — foundational contract/implementation rework before Pilot 001 continues**, followed by a new whole-stack candidate and qualification baseline. Binding-only or Pilot-only repair leaves causally central authority, effect, reconciliation and recovery defects intact. This does not recommend wholesale erasure of the architecture, source history, replacement E1 or preserved E2.

[Sealed full report](https://github.com/417properties/IRIS-Personal-Office/blob/ef7fea887729f9e2a1864990eaa2fb1da15135ce/artifacts/reviews/iris-full-system/2026-10-03-work-audit/IRIS-FULL-SYSTEM-DEEP-AUDIT.md) · [All 11 package files](https://github.com/417properties/IRIS-Personal-Office/tree/ef7fea887729f9e2a1864990eaa2fb1da15135ce/artifacts/reviews/iris-full-system/2026-10-03-work-audit) · [Seal manifest](https://github.com/417properties/IRIS-Personal-Office/blob/ef7fea887729f9e2a1864990eaa2fb1da15135ce/artifacts/reviews/iris-full-system/2026-10-03-work-audit/SEAL.json)

## Material disposition

The report contains **20 causal defect classes**, each with source coordinates, governing invariant, L1–L5, competing explanation, recurrence control and owner. F1/F2 are independently supported. Additional classes include incomplete item/UNKNOWN routing, overconsolidated resolution identity, principal/value/time-unbound authority, retry-path bypass, partial-effect misclassification, unsupported objective closure, incompatible recovery predicates, nonexclusive continuation, canonical repository/schema mismatch, incomplete lease/sentinel validation, projection snapshot/audit gaps, qualification/persistence shortcuts and causal-measurement limits.

All **63 accepted foundation files are byte-identical** in the frozen Pilot candidate. Thus the foundational findings are inherited, not attributed to recent transition patches. The narrow bee076 intent-only and early contract-mismatch repairs remain earned in their actual scope. Replacement E1 structure and identity remain preserved; no source-backed E1 regeneration/relabeling requirement was established.

## Attachments and completion

FULL_MATERIAL_DEFECT_REGISTER / L1_L5_CAUSAL_ANALYSIS / FOUNDATIONAL_IRIS_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX / PILOT001_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX / TEST_ORACLE_INTEGRITY_AUDIT / UNKNOWN_TAXONOMY_AND_PATH_MATRIX / AUTHORITY_END_TO_END_AUDIT / DURABILITY_RECONSTRUCTION_AUDIT / REPLAY_DEDUP_CAUSAL_IDENTITY_AUDIT / INSTITUTIONAL_LEARNING_INTEGRITY_AUDIT / MEASUREMENT_GOODHART_OBSERVABILITY_AUDIT / FILTRATION_CONDITIONED_COGNITION_AUDIT / STATE_MACHINE_AUDIT / CROSS_LAYER_CONTRACT_AUDIT / PREVIOUS_PASS_REVALIDATION / SALVAGE_BOUNDARY_ADJUDICATION / REPAIR_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH / REPAIR_OWNER_MAP / CONSOLIDATED_REQUALIFICATION_ARCHITECTURE / PREDICTIVE_FAILURE_ENVELOPE / AUDITOR_SELF_AUDIT / AUDIT_SURFACE_COMPLETION — all included.

Additional mechanical attachments: 69 traceability groups; complete test-source index; **84-root census and 2,016 constructor-field witnesses**, explicitly a failed totality proof at the missing conflict-only ID, not a manufactured PASS; field domains; source/hash inventory.

**AUDIT_SURFACE_COMPLETION = 100%** of enumerated authorized frozen inputs plus full-repository expansion. No unreadable required exact object. Completion is source consumption, not semantic acceptance.

**Independence limitation preserved:** historical E3-result information was automatically exposed earlier in this conversation and previously disclosed at BIG #703/5965902859 and IRIS #3/5965903761. No protected E2 answer, candidate output vector or E3 artifact was fetched; no score was used in findings or configuration. This report does **not** certify clean-room evaluator independence and cannot substitute for a newly admitted independent acceptance worker.

No candidate code/tests, buildProjection, candidate evaluation or scoring was executed. Mechanical work was limited to retrieval, hashes, structural comparison, source census and artifact assembly.

## Proposed consolidated next architecture

A: reconcile canonical contracts → B: shared semantic kernel/candidate repair + C: independent oracle/binding derivation → D: one whole-stack requalification → E: one fresh independent acceptance. Five conditional recurrence paths are analyzed and their preventive controls incorporated. Any downstream evaluation, E3, admission or continuity requires separate STRATA adjudication/release.

**STOP_FOR_STRATA / ZERO_AUTHORITY / CONTINUITY_DEFAULT_OFF / IRIS_NOT_OPERATIONALLY_PROMOTED / BIG_ACTIVATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED / DELTA_RECONCILIATION_NOT_ERASURE**

This is the complete audit return, not authority to perform the proposed repairs.
